import json,runpy,socket
from unittest.mock import patch
import psycopg
from maskgw.runtime import candidate as c
from maskgw.runtime.snapshot import RecordingSecrets,capture_template
from maskgw.datasource.models import DatasourcePolicy,DatasourceLimits
from maskgw.secretsource import MappingSecretProvider
T=runpy.run_path("tests/test_runtime_snapshot.py")
policies=[{},{"masking":[{"match":"email","transformer":"hmac_sha256"}]}]
checks=[]
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs):raise AssertionError("EXTERNAL_IO_IN_PURE_CAPTURE")
with patch.object(psycopg,"connect",forbidden),patch.object(socket,"getaddrinfo",forbidden):
 for raw in policies:
  for limits in [DatasourceLimits(),DatasourceLimits(max_rows=7,statement_timeout_ms=1234)]:
   prepared=T["prepare"](raw,limits=limits)
   policy=DatasourcePolicy.from_mapping(raw)
   recorder=RecordingSecrets(MappingSecretProvider({T["HMAC_KEY_ENV"]:T["KEY_A"]}))
   loaded=c.parse_config_bundle(policy.to_mapping(),secrets=recorder)
   settings=c.effective_database_settings(loaded.file_config,limits)
   config=c.GatewayConfig(masking=loaded.gateway.masking,database=settings,sql=loaded.gateway.sql)
   template=capture_template(policy,config,T["rebuild"](prepared).connection_target(),recorder)
   checks.append(template.bind(T["IDENTITY"])==T["encoded"](prepared))
print(json.dumps({"cases":len(checks),"all_template_bytes_equal":all(checks),"external_connect_dns_trapped":True,"uses_new_runtime_api":False}))
raise SystemExit(not all(checks))
scope: Validation only using synthetic existing test fixtures; comparator uses frozen build_candidate fake fixture. The proposed pure controller path does not call build_candidate or supply a no-op verifier.
harness_corrections: Initial review harness requested absent PreparedRuntime.conninfo; corrected to public RecompiledSnapshot.connection_target().
Initial synthetic policy used unsupported column_pattern key; corrected to existing match field. Neither was a product finding.
conclusion: Existing public normal loader + effective_database_settings + GatewayConfig + capture_template provide pure composition. New production API and image rebuild are not established as necessary.
